title: AntBuddy Mobile — CRM Omni-channel App
summary: Production CRM mobile app (iOS + Android) for omni-channel customer support. Worked on call system, TikTok channel, push notification lifecycle, and Omni inbox.
content: Role: Frontend Developer at AntBuddy JSC (01/2026 – present).

Call system: integrated CRM call history, showed customer name in call history, fixed call type handling and auto-save race conditions, fixed FCM token cleanup on signout to prevent calls being received after logout.
TikTok channel: added TikTok messaging support and UI, implemented filter for TikTok conversations, rendered lead questions and answers in message container.
Omni-channel inbox: updated action menu to conditionally show reply/forward based on message channel, added copy text functionality.
Push notifications: fixed device token registration/unregistration lifecycle on iOS and Android — ensuring correct behavior on login, signout, and SwitchCompany.
Tickets: added navigation to Tickets screen with initial filter for assigned tickets.
Cross-platform maintenance across saas-android and saas-ios branches. Repository is private — production product at AntBuddy JSC.

title: AntBuddy Autotest — E2E Mobile Automation
summary: End-to-end automation test framework for AntBuddy's Zalo OA FlowBot. 83 UAT specs covering onboarding, bot flows, and CRM API verification on real iOS/Android devices.
content: Role: Frontend Developer at AntBuddy JSC — built and maintained the automation test framework.
Architecture: Playwright as test runner orchestrating Appium (XCUITest on iOS, UiAutomator2 on Android) via WebDriverIO for real-device control.
Covered 83 UAT test specs across onboarding, FlowBot conversation flows, CTA interactions, and Zalo OA follow/unfollow.
CRM API verification layer: each test validates backend state via CRM/Omni API in addition to UI assertions (dual-layer verification).
OCR integration using Tesseract.js to read text content directly from device screenshots when Appium selectors are not reliable.
Report pipeline: HTML report, JSON result, Excel export, auto-generated dashboard, and ZIP artifact — all from a single npm run report:full command.
Custom utility modules: bot-assertions.js (keyword normalization + Vietnamese diacritic-insensitive matching), zalo-actions.js, crm-api-helper.js, android-bottom-sheet.js.
Repository is private — internal tooling at AntBuddy JSC.

title: JinStore — Cross-platform Sales System
summary: Personal fullstack commerce system with web and mobile apps. Google login, OTP, VNPay payment, Cloudinary storage, and WebSocket realtime updates.
content: Personal project started 02/2025, ongoing.
Built web frontend (React JS + SCSS), mobile app (React Native), and REST API backend (Node.js + Express + MongoDB) from scratch.
Integrated Google OAuth login, OTP account verification, VNPay payment gateway, and Cloudinary for image storage.
State management: Redux Toolkit on mobile, Zustand on web. Realtime order updates via WebSocket.
